repositories.description: The easiest way to get started with OpenTUI is by using create-tui. This CLI tool enables you to quickly start building a new OpenTUI application, with everything set up for you.

repositories.name: mcp-client-for-ollama
repositories.description: Harness the power of local LLMs with this TUI MCP Client for Ollama. Featuring all core MCP primitives (tools, prompts, resources), agent mode, multi-server, model switching, streaming responses, human-in-the-loop, thinking mode, model params config, system prompts, and saved preferences.

repositories.name: ai4j
repositories.description: Java 8+ agentic SDK: unified LLM access (OpenAI/Anthropic/DashScope/Doubao/DeepSeek...),unified AI service(image/video/audio...), Tool Calling, MCP, RAG, SKILLS,Agent Runtime, A2A, agent blueprint, agent harness, and a built-in Coding Agent CLI/TUI/ACP.

repositories.name: fzf-make
repositories.description: A command line tool that executes commands using fuzzy finder with preview window for make, npm, pnpm, yarn, just and task.

repositories.name: cs
repositories.description: codespelunker - CLI code search tool that understands code structure and ranks results by relevance. No indexing required with CLI, TUI, MCP and HTTP support.
